title: Fact Checker for Valmiki Ramayana
description: AI-powered fact checker developed for the IYD Hackathon 2025.
problem: Manual verification of events in ancient epics is prone to human error and time-consuming.
solution: Utilizes deep learning textual analysis to cross-reference verses and identify factual consistencies.

title: RAG Chatbot for Bhagavad Gita
description: Insightful responses using verses from the Bhagavad Gita and Yoga Sutras.
problem: Traditional search engines provide literal results rather than contextual wisdom.
solution: Implements Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to provide grounded, philosophically accurate insights.

title: Bhagavad Gita Portal
description: An elegant web portal presenting the verses of the Bhagavad Gita for the modern age.
problem: Complex Sanskrit verses are often digitally inaccessible due to poor presentation.
solution: High-performance web architecture designed for readability, featuring fast search and multi-language support.

title: Fine-Tuning Flux
description: Advanced fine-tuning of Flux 1.0 using custom image datasets.
problem: Base generative models lack specificity for complex multi-subject interactions and unique cultural attire.
solution: Employs LoRA fine-tuning on custom curated image datasets to precisely control posture and costume.

title: Fictometer
description: An algorithm to detect manipulative content using NLP and Logistic Regression.
problem: Manipulative and fabricated digital content spreads rapidly without automated tools for detection.
solution: Uses Logistic Regression and NLP features to calculate a definitive 'Fictivity' score for any input text.

title: Soorma Bhopali AI
description: A character-driven chatbot that provides information about Bhopal in an iconic cinematic tone.
problem: General-purpose chatbots lack personality and local cultural context.
solution: An AI entity modeled after the Sholay character, blending local knowledge with specialized dialect modeling.
